caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned centrally against a plain, beige background. The chair has a dark brown wooden frame with ornate carvings along the top of the rounded backrest and along the edges of the seat. The backrest and seat are upholstered in a light, simultaneously muted and patterned fabric, featuring soft shades of tan, green, and muted red with a faint floral motif. The upholstery on the backrest is diamond-tufted with button details. The legs of the chair are curved, adding an element of decorative design, and the entire chair is rendered with attention to shadow and detail, giving it a realistic appearance within the empty space of the otherwise blank background.
title: Side Chair
